name: Race And Discrimination
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that God does not show partiality based on race or social status, as He is the Creator of all people and the God of gods who judges righteously rather than by outward appearance. Believers are instructed to treat strangers with kindness and not to oppress them, recognizing that all humanity shares one Father. This divine impartiality calls Christians to reject discrimination and to honor the covenant of brotherhood by acting justly toward one another.
